description: Rb₂NaCo(CN)₆ is Potassium Silver Cyanide-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Rb is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five N atoms. There are a spread of Rb-N bond distances ranging from 3.07-3.43 Å. Na is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six N atoms. There are a spread of Na-N bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.57 Å. Co is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six C atoms. There are two shorter (1.87 Å) and four longer (1.88 Å) Co-C bond lengths. There are three inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the second C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. In the third C site, C is bonded in a linear geometry to one Co and one N atom. The C-N bond length is 1.18 Å. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one C atom. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Rb, one Na, and one C atom. In the third N site, N is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, and one C atom.
